correctness.rationale: For fixed g,gamma>0 and Delta real, every rank-one detector jump resets the qubit to |1>, so interclick waits regenerate and have exponential tails. The four-real-coordinate no-click generator leads by direct 4x4 determinant to exact rational Laplace transform fhat(s). The analytic renewal pole s(q), q=log(1/fhat(s)), has derivatives K_j=s^(j)(0). Independent symbolic series reversion at (g,gamma,Delta)=(1,1,0),(1,1,1),(1,1,2) reproduced all four displayed cumulants, including detuning-independent K3=7/8 and K4=2157/1024,1273/1024,-23843/1024. For u>0, P(u,v) has negative second v-derivative; at v=0 its cubic in u has one positive root by Descartes, and for u beyond that root initial v-slope is negative. This gives the exactly one crossing and boundary equality cases. The proof is asymptotic in t at fixed nonzero parameters, not finite time or singular g->0.
